goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Represent each original KI wide-waveform unit's standardized [log10 firing rate, burstiness, memory] vector by its best-matching SOM prototype, assessed by the original Extended Data Figure2c,d quantization-error panel. primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Represent each original KI wide-waveform unit's standardized [log10 firing rate, burstiness, memory] vector by its best-matching SOM prototype, assessed by the original Extended Data Figure2c,d quantization-error panel. Preserve original map capacity and topology; descriptive regional enrichment/hierarchy correlations are not optimization targets.

Source-paper comparison for Original Extended Data Figure2c,d quantization-error medians across the complete fixed region panel: For unit j with standardized feature vector z_j and its nearest source-map prototype w_BMN(j), QError_j=||z_j-w_BMN(j)||_2. Lower is better. Compute in the same fixed standardized coordinates and original-capacity SOM; shrinking feature scales, adding nodes or replacing the output with per-unit memorization does not improve the same task.
success_criteria: Recover exact original unit features, masks, standardization, source map node count/topology and Extended Data Figure2c,d QError values for every original region.
Reproduce the original-capacity author SOM and its complete region-wise QError panel before comparing candidate methods.
Freeze candidate map-learning method, original capacity/output constraints, allowed feature access, full-panel decision, meaningful effect, uncertainty and resource budgets before scoring.

Show a justified reduction of original QError under the full fixed-panel rule without changing node count, feature scale, population, representation constraints or source in-sample evaluation condition.

Retain Figure4 descriptive maps as calibration. Conditional-moment agreement, stronger hierarchy correlations or performance on a new held-animal energy-score split cannot satisfy this source-task win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
